Article 5.4: Winning Days (Tracking and Requirements)

Warren's summary

Standard MAX accounts in evaluation must achieve 5 winning days to pass, while Express MAX accounts in evaluation need only 2 winning days. Express MAX funded accounts must accumulate 5 winning days before each withdrawal, but Standard MAX funded accounts have no winning day requirement for payouts. A winning day is determined by the account's net profit at the end of the trading session meeting or exceeding the threshold ($100 for $25,000 accounts, $150 for $50,000, $200 for $100,000, $250 for $150,000, and $300 for $250,000), with only closing P&L counting, not intraday highs. You can track your winning days on the FFN dashboard, and support can help confirm your count if there is a dispute.

Who Needs Winning Days?
Account Type / Phase	Winning Days Required?	Purpose
Standard MAX: Evaluation	YES: 5 to PASS evaluation	Must have 5 winning days to complete evaluation
Standard MAX: Funded	NO: not required for payouts	No winning day requirement for withdrawals
Express MAX: Evaluation	YES: 2 to PASS ('2 Day Funded')	Must have 2 winning days to complete evaluation
Express MAX: Funded	YES: 5 per payout	Must accumulate 5 winning days before each withdrawal
Standard OG / Express OG	NO	No winning day requirement
What Counts as a Winning Day?
The account's NET profit at the END of the trading session must be at or above the threshold.
Intraday highs do NOT count, only the closing net P&L matters.
Sessions where the DLL soft breach was triggered: the day may still count as a winning day IF the net P&L at the time of lockout met the threshold.
Minimum Net P&L Thresholds for a Winning Day
Account Size	Minimum Daily Net P&L
$25,000	$100
$50,000	$150
$100,000	$200
$150,000	$250
$250,000	$300
How to Track Winning Days

The FFN dashboard displays your daily P&L history. Traders are responsible for tracking their own winning day count. FFN support can assist in confirming your count if there is a dispute.
